title: The printer prints its own hologram

plate.label: FOOTAGE: POV walks past the Bambu to the Prusa Core One, then holds on its print head
plate.sub: REAL · printer_1_core_one.mp4 from 0.4 s · 16:9 window 12% down the portrait frame · orange parts printing on the bed

anchor_doc: Hologram square centred at x,y with side w (1920x1080 px, before the push). In the square the model spans v 0.11 (spool top) to 0.82 (base front), u 0.25-0.70. Placement rule: a glowing twin standing on the real bed, right of the orange parts, base on the bed's front edge. rot = roll deg; yaw/pitch = deg added to the model view (beat 0: yaw 28, pitch 16).
push_doc: Digital push on plate and hologram together: zoom z about (cx, cy). Set z to 1 if the real clip already pushes enough.

trigger.doc: pinch ring + corner brackets; u,v in holo square (0..1). Move to the hand if a pinch is in shot.

print.doc: layers done = layers * ((t - t0)/(t1 - t0))^warp: slow first layers so the nozzle reads, then timelapse fast

label.text: It lays hot plastic down, one layer at a time.
label.doc: x,y = left baseline of the label in px; to = leader end in the holo square (0..1), aim it at the printed part on the real bed

smallprint.text: Visualised. On the glasses it's a panel in your view.

cues.sound: room tone + real printer hum and footsteps from the clip, low
stepper ticks, one per layer for the first 5 layers
ticks blur into a rising whirr as the layers speed up
short hiss (plastic cools) + gentle chime as the model completes
